label: Information Extraction
description: The task of automatically extracting structured information from unstructured text

label: Relation Extraction
description: Identifying semantic relationships between entities mentioned in text

label: Named Entity Recognition
description: Identifying and classifying named entities (persons, organizations, locations, etc.) in text

label: Open Information Extraction
description: Domain-independent extraction of relational tuples from text without pre-specified schemas

label: Distant Supervision
description: Using existing knowledge bases to automatically generate training data for relation extraction by aligning KB triples with text

label: Knowledge Graph Construction
description: Automatically building knowledge graphs from unstructured text sources

label: Joint Entity and Relation Extraction
description: Simultaneously extracting entities and their relations in a unified model rather than pipeline approach

label: Few-Shot Learning
description: Learning from very few labeled examples, often using meta-learning or prototypical networks

label: Event Extraction
description: Identifying event triggers and their arguments from text

label: Document-Level Relation Extraction
description: Extracting relations that span multiple sentences within a document

label: Transformer Architecture
description: Neural network architecture based on self-attention mechanisms, foundation of modern NLP

label: Pre-trained Language Model
description: Large neural models pre-trained on vast text corpora and fine-tuned for downstream tasks

label: Conditional Random Field
description: Probabilistic graphical model for structured prediction, widely used for sequence labeling

label: Convolutional Neural Network
description: Neural network using convolutional layers, applied to both vision and NLP tasks

label: Graph Neural Network
description: Neural network operating on graph-structured data, used for dependency-tree-based relation extraction

label: Multi-Instance Learning
description: Learning paradigm where labels are assigned to bags of instances rather than individual instances

label: Sequence-to-Sequence
description: Encoder-decoder framework that maps input sequences to output sequences

label: Cross-Lingual Information Extraction
description: Information extraction across different languages using multilingual models

label: Biomedical Information Extraction
description: Information extraction from biomedical and clinical text

label: Span-Based Extraction
description: Identifying text spans for entities and relations rather than token-level tagging

label: Triple Extraction
description: Extracting (subject, predicate, object) triples from text

label: Generative Information Extraction
description: Using generative language models to produce structured IE outputs as text sequences

label: Temporal Relation Extraction
description: Extracting temporal ordering relations between events and time expressions

title: TextRunner: Open Information Extraction on the Web
abstract_short: First Open Information Extraction system that extracts relational tuples from web text without pre-specified relations, using self-supervised learning over unlabeled text.

title: Identifying Relations for Open Information Extraction
abstract_short: ReVerb identifies and extracts binary relationships from English sentences using syntactic constraints, substantially improving precision over TextRunner.

title: Open Information Extraction: The Second Generation
abstract_short: Describes the second generation of Open IE systems that double precision/recall compared to TextRunner and WOE through novel modeling of how relations are expressed in English.

title: OpenIE6: Iterative Grid Labeling and Coordination Analysis for Open Information Extraction
abstract_short: State-of-the-art OpenIE system using novel Iterative Grid Labeling architecture that treats OpenIE as a 2-D grid labeling task, achieving 4pt F1 improvement while running 10x faster.

title: Distant Supervision for Relation Extraction without Labeled Data
abstract_short: Introduces distant supervision paradigm: automatically generating training data for relation extraction by aligning Freebase relations with text, eliminating need for hand-labeled data.

title: Modeling Relations and Their Mentions without Labeled Text
abstract_short: Relaxes distant supervision assumption by modeling it as multi-instance learning, where at least one sentence in a bag must express the relation. Creates the widely-used NYT dataset.

title: Relation Classification via Convolutional Deep Neural Network
abstract_short: First application of convolutional neural networks to relation classification, learning features automatically from sentences without hand-crafted features.

title: Distant Supervision for Relation Extraction via Piecewise Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract_short: Proposes PCNN with piecewise max pooling that divides sentence into three segments based on entity positions, yielding richer representations for distantly supervised relation extraction.

title: Neural Relation Extraction with Selective Attention over Instances
abstract_short: Proposes sentence-level selective attention to reduce noise in distantly supervised RE by weighting sentences in a bag, significantly improving extraction quality.

title: Attention Is All You Need
abstract_short: Introduces the Transformer architecture based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions. Foundation of all modern large language models.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
abstract_short: Introduces BERT, a bidirectional transformer pre-trained on masked language modeling and next sentence prediction. Revolutionizes NLP including NER and relation extraction.

title: SpanBERT: Improving Pre-training by Representing and Predicting Spans
abstract_short: Extends BERT by masking contiguous random spans and training span boundary representations, achieving strong results on relation extraction (TACRED) and other span-selection tasks.

title: LUKE: Deep Contextualized Entity Representations with Entity-aware Self-attention
abstract_short: Pre-trained entity representations using entity-aware self-attention. Achieves SOTA on entity typing, relation extraction (TACRED), and NER (CoNLL-2003).

title: DocRED: A Large-Scale Document-Level Relation Extraction Dataset
abstract_short: Largest human-annotated dataset for document-level relation extraction, constructed from Wikipedia and Wikidata, requiring reasoning over multiple sentences.

title: REBEL: Relation Extraction By End-to-end Language Generation
abstract_short: End-to-end relation extraction using seq2seq generation with BART, treating RE as a text generation problem. Linearizes triples into token sequences for autoregressive generation.

title: UniRel: Unified Representation and Interaction for Joint Relational Triple Extraction
abstract_short: Unifies entity and relation representations by jointly encoding them within a concatenated natural language sequence, with an Interaction Map for modeling dependencies.

title: Packed Levitated Marker for Entity and Relation Extraction
abstract_short: PL-Marker proposes packed levitated markers that consider interrelation between spans by strategically packing markers in the encoder for joint entity and relation extraction.

title: Incremental Knowledge Base Construction Using DeepDive
abstract_short: DeepDive system for knowledge base construction combining database and ML techniques, achieving human-caliber quality at machine scale in domains like pharmacogenomics and paleobiology.

title: Conditional Random Fields: Probabilistic Models for Segmenting and Labeling Sequence Data
abstract_short: Introduces CRFs for structured prediction, overcoming label bias problem in MEMMs. Foundation for sequence labeling tasks including NER.

title: Incorporating Non-local Information into Information Extraction Systems by Gibbs Sampling
abstract_short: Stanford NER system using CRF with non-local features via Gibbs sampling. Foundational NER tool widely used in NLP research and industry.

title: spaCy: Industrial-strength Natural Language Processing in Python
abstract_short: Industrial-strength NLP library including NER, dependency parsing, and text classification. Widely adopted for production NLP systems.

title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
abstract_short: GPT-3: 175B parameter autoregressive language model demonstrating strong few-shot learning across NLP tasks including information extraction via in-context learning.

title: GPT-4 Technical Report
abstract_short: GPT-4 multimodal model accepting image and text inputs. Achieves human-level performance on professional benchmarks, widely applied to IE tasks.

title: BioBERT: a pre-trained biomedical language representation model for biomedical text mining
abstract_short: Domain-specific BERT pre-trained on PubMed abstracts and PMC full-text articles, achieving SOTA on biomedical NER, RE, and QA tasks.

title: Domain-Specific Language Model Pretraining for Biomedical Natural Language Processing
abstract_short: PubMedBERT: demonstrates that pretraining from scratch on biomedical text outperforms continual pretraining, due to in-domain vocabulary advantages. SOTA on BLURB benchmark.

title: FewRel: A Large-Scale Supervised Few-Shot Relation Classification Dataset with State-of-the-Art Evaluation
abstract_short: Largest supervised few-shot relation extraction dataset with 70K sentences across 100 relations from Wikipedia. Establishes benchmarks for few-shot RE.

title: Position-aware Attention and Supervised Data Improve Slot Filling
abstract_short: Introduces TACRED, the largest supervised relation extraction dataset with 106K examples over 41 relation types from TAC KBP. Also proposes position-aware attention for slot filling.

title: Unsupervised Cross-lingual Representation Learning at Scale
abstract_short: XLM-RoBERTa: multilingual model trained on 100 languages using 2TB CommonCrawl data. Achieves competitive performance with monolingual models, strong on cross-lingual NER.

title: End-to-End Relation Extraction using LSTMs on Sequences and Tree Structures
abstract_short: Joint entity and relation extraction using stacked bidirectional tree-structured and sequential LSTMs with shared parameters. 12.1% error reduction on ACE2005.

title: Attention Guided Graph Convolutional Networks for Relation Extraction
abstract_short: AGGCN: soft-pruning approach using self-attention to transform dependency trees into fully connected edge-weighted graphs for relation extraction. SOTA on TACRED and SemEval.

title: A Novel Cascade Binary Tagging Framework for Relational Triple Extraction
abstract_short: CasRel: models relations as functions mapping subjects to objects via cascade binary tagging. 17.5 and 30.2 F1 gains on NYT and WebNLG datasets.

title: Span-based Joint Entity and Relation Extraction with Transformer Pre-training
abstract_short: SpERT: span-based approach using BERT for joint entity and relation extraction. Classifies all spans into entity types, then classifies entity pair relations with localized context.

title: A Frustratingly Easy Approach for Entity and Relation Extraction
abstract_short: PURE: simple pipeline approach with typed entity markers achieving SOTA on ACE04, ACE05, SciERC. Shows distinct contextual representations for entities and relations are key.

title: Revisiting Relation Extraction in the era of Large Language Models
abstract_short: Evaluates GPT-3 and Flan-T5 for RE. Finds fine-tuned Flan-T5 achieves SOTA, argues LLMs should be the default approach to RE with human evaluation addressing generative evaluation issues.

title: Large Language Models for Generative Information Extraction: A Survey
abstract_short: Comprehensive survey of LLM-based generative information extraction covering NER, RE, event extraction, and universal IE, categorizing techniques and analyzing emerging trends.

title: GenIE: Generative Information Extraction
abstract_short: Autoregressive IE generating (subject, relation, object) triples. Uses bi-level constrained generation to ensure KB schema consistency. SOTA on closed IE.

title: InstructUIE: Multi-task Instruction Tuning for Unified Information Extraction
abstract_short: Unified IE framework via instruction tuning on 32 datasets. Outperforms GPT-3.5 in zero-shot settings by capturing inter-task dependencies across NER, RE, and EE.

title: ChatIE: Zero-Shot Information Extraction via Chatting with ChatGPT
abstract_short: Zero-shot IE using ChatGPT via multi-turn QA framework. Improves performance by 16.65% on average across RE, NER, and EE tasks in English and Chinese.

title: LLMs for Knowledge Graph Construction and Reasoning: Recent Capabilities and Future Opportunities
abstract_short: Investigates LLMs for KG construction and reasoning, proposes AutoKG method using multiple agents for accomplishing KGC tasks automatically.

title: A Comprehensive Survey on Automatic Knowledge Graph Construction
abstract_short: Reviews 300+ methods for automatic KG construction covering knowledge acquisition, refinement, and evolution from unstructured sources.

title: Thinking about GPT-3 In-Context Learning for Biomedical IE? Think Again
abstract_short: Systematic comparison of GPT-3 in-context learning vs fine-tuned BERT-sized models for biomedical NER and RE. Fine-tuned PLMs outperform GPT-3 by 15-16% F1 on NER.

title: GPT-3 Powered Information Extraction for Building Robust Knowledge Bases
abstract_short: Uses GPT-3 for information extraction to build knowledge bases, exploring prompt engineering strategies for structured extraction from unstructured text.

title: Hybrid Attention-Based Prototypical Networks for Noisy Few-Shot Relation Classification
abstract_short: Proposes hybrid attention-based prototypical networks with instance-level and feature-level attention for few-shot relation classification under noise.

title: Event Extraction as Machine Reading Comprehension
abstract_short: Casts event extraction as machine reading comprehension, enabling stronger reasoning and achieving SOTA on event extraction benchmarks.

title: Document-Level Event Argument Extraction by Conditional Generation
abstract_short: Document-level event argument extraction via conditional generation following event templates. Introduces WIKIEVENTS benchmark dataset.

title: TempEval-3: Evaluating Events, Time Expressions, and Temporal Relations
abstract_short: Shared task evaluating temporal information extraction: event detection, time expression recognition, and temporal relation classification. Key benchmark for temporal IE.

title: OneRel: Joint Entity and Relation Extraction with One Module in One Step
abstract_short: Casts joint extraction as fine-grained triple classification with scoring-based classifier and relation-specific horns tagging. Achieves SOTA on NYT and WebNLG.

title: TPLinker: Single-stage Joint Extraction of Entities and Relations Through Token Pair Linking
abstract_short: Formulates joint extraction as token pair linking with handshaking tagging scheme, achieving single-stage extraction without entity-relation exposure bias.

title: Generative Knowledge Graph Construction: A Review
abstract_short: Reviews generative approaches to KG construction using sequence-to-sequence frameworks, covering entity extraction, relation extraction, and event extraction.

title: Extract, Define, Canonicalize: An LLM-based Framework for Knowledge Graph Construction
abstract_short: EDC framework decomposes KGC into three phases: extraction, definition, and canonicalization using LLMs for structured and consistent KG construction.
